Definition: from a derivative of G2827; properly, reclination, i.e. (concretely and specially), a party at a meal:--company.
BiblicalUsage: Klisia is a company at a meal, a party seated together. Luke 9:14 says the five thousand were made to sit down by fifties in a company, before the loaves were broken.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the companies are the order before the miracle: five thousand men seated in fifties, because God feeds His people in order, not in a crowd.
